editorial.blurb: Cowabunga! Pizza Pies serves phenomenal New York-style slices in a whimsical Ninja Turtles-themed space where the staff's warmth matches the quality of the pizza.
editorial.insiderTip: Come hungry and try slices of multiple varieties—the Shark Attack and Godfather are standouts, and staff encourage sampling different kinds. Arrive early to avoid running out of offerings.

topDishes.note: Reviewers rave about this signature slice
